text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

words.gloss_range: opening consequence particle that carries the prior proclamation into the report of factional disagreement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah in dependency on what came before: the disagreement is presented as a consequence and narrative resumption after the prior proclamation, not as an isolated historical note. Its bound placement before the verb makes the hinge compact, and the later second particle turns the ayah into a two-step chain from proclamation to fracture to woe.

topics.headline: opening consequence after the prior claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader carries the prior proclamation into the first verb and hears the split as a response to that claim.
topics.reason: Particle grammar and boundary rows both make the opening a dependent launch from the previous statement.

topics.headline: proclitic joins the hinge to the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consequence is not detached from the action but attached to the verb onset.
topics.reason: The particle is a conjunction prefix on the following verb, so the formal fusion supports the hinge reading.

topics.headline: first of two consequence particles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first consequence marker setting up the later marker before the woe clause.
topics.reason: The row is supported by the repeated particle at word 6 and by the two-clause result structure.

words.gloss_range: completed reciprocal disagreement in which organized parties diverge internally after a prior claim
words.root_gloss_range: root range around coming after, succeeding, remaining behind, differing, and opposition; the local Form VIII selects reciprocal divergence while afterness and behindness remain image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:اخْتَلَفَ}} ({{tr:ikhtalafa}}) foregrounds the act before naming the factions: a completed fracture is placed first, then its plural subject arrives. The Form VIII shape makes the split reciprocal and self-involving, while the wider {{ar:خ ل ف}} ({{tr:kh-l-f}}) field lets the disagreement feel like going different ways after a straight-path standard has just been stated. The same opening recurs in the Quranic doublet (43:65), so the verb also sits in a recognizable pattern where communities fracture and judgment follows. Its rough consonantal movement lets the sound itself briefly enact fracture before the smoother nominal phrase resumes.

topics.headline: completed event before delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets the fracture as an accomplished event before the actors are named.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb before an explicit plural subject, and attachment makes the following noun its subject.

topics.headline: Form VIII internalizes the split
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the community as both the arena and producer of the disagreement.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form VIII and intransitive with an internal source phrase, supporting reciprocal divergence rather than external opposition.

topics.headline: afterness colors divergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses disagreement as movement away after a just-stated straight-path claim, while local morphology keeps reciprocal difference as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The wider root field is valid image pressure, but the local Form VIII verb selects disagreement rather than succession or causative leaving-behind.

topics.headline: fracture belongs to a judgment pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this fracture as part of a recurring Quranic pattern, especially the close doublet (43:65).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels, and nothing in the local grammar blocks treating them as formulaic echoes.

topics.headline: rough articulation suits fracture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the broken consonantal texture reinforcing the verb of splitting.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a small but concrete payoff without changing the lexical parse.

words.gloss_range: definite plural subject naming recognizable organized factions rather than an abstract principle of division
words.root_gloss_range: root range around party, faction, coalition, troop, and gathered opposition, with hardship pressure in the wider family; local plural selects embodied factions
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَحْزَابُ}} ({{tr:al-aḥzābu}}) identifies the actors after the verb has already made fracture prominent. The article and nominative role make them recognizable agents of the split, while the broken concrete plural presents multiple organized blocs rather than one vague opposition. The {{ar:ح ز ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-z-b}}) field brings coalition and confederate pressure into the doctrinal dispute, with a linked disbelief outcome in another factional warning (11:17) and a contrast to the winning party of God (5:56); the local sense remains factions, while the recitation-division sense stays background irony. The long opening vowel broadens the factional beat before the phrase tightens into the inner-source wording.

topics.headline: recognizable factions as delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader learns that the split belongs to identifiable factions, not to an unnamed abstract disagreement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make the word the definite nominative subject of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: broken plural names embodied blocs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures organized blocs multiplying inside the disagreement rather than a single undifferentiated group.
topics.reason: The local noun is a concrete broken plural, and the reciprocal verb fits multiple organized parties.

topics.headline: wider party field adds pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses gathered-party and hardship pressure, while the local word still means factions in the social dispute.
topics.reason: The broader root observations are meaningful but do not replace the local concrete plural faction reading.

topics.headline: Quranic confederate opposition frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the term in a wider Quranic register of confederated opposition, including a linked disbelief outcome (11:17).
topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete uses of the same noun field and cohere with the local organized-opposition sense.

topics.headline: sound moves from broad blocs inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the large factional beat narrow toward the inner-source phrase.
topics.reason: The sound row supports the movement from the plural blocs to the following internal-space phrase.

words.gloss_range: source preposition that makes the following between-phrase diagnose internal origin and membership
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the report of disagreement into a source diagnosis. Before the reader reaches the pronoun, the particle already points to where the fracture came from: not outside pressure, but the relational space among the factions themselves. Its recitational binding to the next word keeps the internal-source construction compact.

topics.headline: source marker for internal fracture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disagreement is traced to the factions own inner space, not left as a bare event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun the governed complement of this preposition and ties the phrase to the verb.

topics.headline: nasal transition binds particle to complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the source particle fused into the between-phrase instead of floating as a detached marker.
topics.reason: The formal rows fit the local prepositional construction and add a small sound-form payoff.

words.gloss_range: their inner between-space, governed after the source preposition and tied by suffix to the factions as the site of fracture
words.root_gloss_range: root range around between-ness, separation, distinction, clarification, and manifestness; local noun selects relational interval while clarity pressure remains an irony
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنِهِمْ}} ({{tr:baynihim}}) makes the fracture internal and relational: the suffix routes the source back to the factions before the later relative clause narrows the culpable class, and the singular interval noun gathers many factional relations into one shared space. The {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) field also carries distinction and clarity pressure, so the split occurs inside the very field that should have made matters clear; that irony is sharpened by the split after clear proofs in a related warning (3:105). This first source phrase anticipates the later source phrase for woe, moving the ayah from where fracture arose to where judgment arises, while witness-between language elsewhere (13:43) shows how between-ness can become a setting for testimony.

topics.headline: suffix routes the source back to the factions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source of disagreement tied back to the same parties just named.
topics.reason: The word is a genitive noun with a third-person plural suffix, and attachment ties it to the source phrase after the verb.

topics.headline: singular between-space holds plural relations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many factional relations compressed into one internal field of rupture.
topics.reason: The local form is governed by the preposition and uses a singular interval noun with a plural suffix.

topics.headline: between-ness carries clarity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses an irony: the fracture happens in a root field associated with distinction and clarity, while the local noun still means their between-space.
topics.reason: The broader root pressure is coherent and same-surah rows support it, but local grammar selects the relational interval sense.

topics.headline: difference and between-ness recur together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the phrase within a wider Quranic field where difference, between-ness, evidence, and witnessing interact.
topics.reason: Concrete CRITICAL parallels support retaining the field without making it govern the local parse.

topics.headline: first source phrase anticipates second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah prepared to answer an internal source of fracture with a later source of woe.
topics.reason: The verse contains two source prepositional phrases, and attachment links the second to the doom clause.

words.gloss_range: second consequence particle that turns the fracture report into the resultative woe verdict
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) shifts the ayah from narrative report into verdict. It makes the doom noun a consequence of the preceding fracture and action-defined disbelief, while also matching the opening particle: first consequence leads to fracture, then consequence leads to woe. The paired source phrases deepen that chain, from fracture arising among them to woe arising from the witnessing scene.

topics.headline: resultative particle before the woe clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doom clause as an outcome, not as a merely coordinated exclamation.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the second clause as result, and the particle is prefixed to the nominal woe formula.

topics.headline: doubled particle and paired sources build the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verse move in ordered steps: prior claim to fracture, fracture to woe, source of fracture to source of woe.
topics.reason: The repeated particle and the two source phrases are both present in the local structure.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative doom noun in a compact nominal verdict, assigned to the following action-defined class
words.root_gloss_range: root field of woe, curse, destruction, and perdition; local Quranic use is a frozen nominal doom expression rather than a performed verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَيْلٌ}} ({{tr:waylun}}) stands as an indefinite nominative doom noun, with the predicate left unspoken. That makes the verdict feel more absolute than a fully spelled-out verbal sentence. The following assignment phrase gives the doom a target, and the later day phrase gives it a source: the word is not mere emotion, but a compact judgment formula whose {{ar:و ي ل}} ({{tr:w-y-l}}) field carries destruction and perdition pressure. Close formulas place woe for disbelievers with a day or fire source (51:60; 38:27), while here the source is the witnessing of a tremendous day. Its tanwīn also joins the later indefinite day and adjective in a shared cadence of unbounded scale.

topics.headline: indefinite nominative doom subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an unspecified but magnified woe standing as the clause focus.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite nominative noun and attachment treats the clause as nominal with the predicate supplied by construction.

topics.headline: doom is assigned to a class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doom is relationally directed, not simply exclaimed into the air.
topics.reason: Attachment shows the following prepositional phrase supplies the predicate or target relation for the doom noun.

topics.headline: curse formula with perdition pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses curse and destruction pressure while local grammar keeps the word as a nominal verdict formula.
topics.reason: The broader semantic rows survive as pressure, but contextual evidence and QAC keep the local surface nominal.

topics.headline: woe formula specialized by the day phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar woe-for-disbelievers formula sharpened here by the witnessing of a tremendous day, with close parallels (51:60; 38:27).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula parallels and the local phrase supplies its distinctive source.

topics.headline: tanwīn links doom, day, and scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the indefinite endings bind doom, day, and greatness into one magnified cadence.
topics.reason: The sound row matches the visible tanwīn on this word and later words in the same clause.

words.gloss_range: preposition assigning the woe to the following relative class as a malefactive target
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the hinge that assigns the doom noun to its target. In this formula it does not mark benefit; it makes woe belong to the class that the relative clause will define. Its fusion into the next word compresses assignment and classification before the culpable verb appears.

topics.headline: doom assigned to its target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the woe grammatically routed to a defined class rather than left general.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the following relative pronoun the prepositional complement in the woe formula.

topics.headline: preposition and class marker compress together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears assignment pressed directly onto the class-defining relative phrase.
topics.reason: The form is a preposition prefix on the relative pronoun, and the sound rows fit that compression.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun that defines the recipients of woe by the following completed act
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) prevents the verdict from resting on a fixed ethnic or faction label. It opens a relative clause, so the condemned class is defined by the action that follows. The plural form keeps the judgment collective, while the relative construction keeps the criterion action-specific.

topics.headline: relative clause defines the condemned class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients of woe are identified by what they did, not by a bare party label.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the relative construction governed by the preposition, and the following verb completes it.

topics.headline: plural relative distributes the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verdict apply across a plural class while remaining tied to the defining act.
topics.reason: The local relative pronoun is masculine plural and agrees with the plural verb that follows.

words.gloss_range: completed plural act of covering, rejecting, or denying the prior truth, with the object supplied by the preceding proclamation rather than stated here
words.root_gloss_range: root range around covering, concealment, denial, ingratitude, and expiatory covering; local Form I selects blameworthy covering or rejection, not expiation
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) completes the relative class with a finished plural act. The object is not named because the prior proclamation and command are still in view; omission makes the refusal pointed rather than vague. The {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) covering image matters here because the clause later answers it with public witnessing: what was covered is brought before a witnessed day. The verb also links the local scene to the Jesus judgment pattern where disbelief, dispute, and the day converge (3:55) and to a later same-surah scene of disbelievers reacting to signs (19:73), without making those parallels replace the local syntax.

topics.headline: unstated object carried from the prior claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the refusal from the prior proclamation instead of treating disbelief as contentless.
topics.reason: The verb is intransitive on the surface, while boundary rows identify the prior command and claim as the carried content.

topics.headline: perfect plural fixes culpability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the charge as a completed collective act that grounds the verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect 3mp verb, and the relative pronoun supplies the class it completes.

topics.headline: covering is answered by witnessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a moral covering or rejection answered by a public witnessing scene, while the local Form I keeps the selected sense as culpable denial rather than expiation.
topics.reason: The covering image is supported by CRITICAL rows and coheres with the later witnessing noun; Form I blocks importing expiatory branches as the local sense.

topics.headline: disbelief joins day and witnessing patterns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this act in a broader judgment field involving day, witnessing, and the Jesus narrative (3:55; 19:73).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete parallels and co-occurrence fields that support the local judgment setting.

words.gloss_range: second source preposition linking the woe to the witnessing scene as cause, origin, or temporal threshold
words.prose: The second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is an interpretive switch. It can make the woe arise because of the witnessing scene, from that scene, or from the time of it; the local attachment supports source or cause without requiring only one English preposition. Because the ayah already used a source preposition for the fracture, this second one mirrors the first: source of schism is answered by source of woe. The nasal contact also presses the source particle audibly into the following witnessing noun.

topics.headline: cause, source, and time remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the woe is tied to the witnessing scene in layered ways, not just by a flat motion-from sense.
topics.reason: Attachment ties the phrase to the woe as source or cause; CRITICAL particle rows preserve causal, ablative, and temporal pressure.

topics.headline: second source phrase mirrors the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed by two source phrases: where fracture came from and where woe comes from.
topics.reason: The two local prepositional phrases are structurally parallel and attach to the two major clause movements.

topics.headline: sound binds source to scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source particle press into the following witnessing noun.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows fit the adjacent nasal contact without altering the syntactic attachment.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct noun naming the witnessing scene, witnessing event, or place/time of witness from which the woe is specified
words.root_gloss_range: root range around witnessing, testimony, being present, causing to testify, and public attestation; local mafal noun selects a witnessed scene or event bound to the day
words.prose: {{ar:مَشْهَدِ}} ({{tr:mashhadi}}) is governed by the source particle and then governs the day, so the witnessing is not free imagery: it is the source scene of the verdict and is bound to that tremendous day. Its form can name a place or time of witnessing and the witnessing event itself, which makes the doom arise from both public scene and evidentiary occurrence. The {{ar:ش ه د}} ({{tr:sh-h-d}}) field directly answers the earlier covering verb: concealment meets public testimony and exposure. The phrase also inverts witnessed-day wording (11:103) and condenses witness, disbelief, and day scenes found elsewhere (16:84; 16:89).

topics.headline: construct source scene bound to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the witnessing scene grammatically tied both to the source preposition and to the day that owns it.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the preposition and construct head governing the following day noun.

topics.headline: place and event readings work together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the woe coming from a public place or time of witness and from the act of witnessing itself.
topics.reason: The local mafal noun is identified in QAC as place, time, or verbal occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows press that ambiguity.

topics.headline: public witness reverses covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the blame verb answered by its undoing: what was covered faces public witnessing.
topics.reason: The local clause contains the covering verb and the witnessing noun, and the source phrase makes the witnessing scene the ground of woe.

topics.headline: witnessing joins day and disbelief scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a Quranic witness-day field, including an inversion of the witnessed-day wording (11:103) and witness scenes with disbelievers (16:84; 16:89).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references, and the local phrase contains the same witness, day, and disbelief fields.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive day that depends on the witnessing noun while carrying the adjective of tremendousness
words.root_gloss_range: root range of day, time, appointed period, and decisive event; local use names the eschatological day as the temporal frame of witnessing and woe
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:yawmin}}) is the hinge of the closing phrase. It depends upward on the witnessing noun, yet it also receives the final adjective, so the scene becomes the witnessing of a day that is itself tremendous. Its indefiniteness does not make the day vague; with the adjective it magnifies the known judgment frame beyond ordinary bounded time, and the repeated indefinite ending binds doom, day, and greatness into one cadence. The phrase also recalls prophetic warning language where a tremendous day is feared (26:135; 7:59; 10:15), but here the woe is already announced from that day.

topics.headline: dependent noun and adjective head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the day mediate between witnessing on the left and greatness on the right.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the word the genitive complement of the witnessing noun and the head modified by the adjective.

topics.headline: indefinite day magnifies judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the indefinite day as magnified, not vague, inside the eschatological phrase.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite and genitive, and the following adjective shares the indefinite magnifying pattern.

topics.headline: tremendous-day formula shifted to woe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes prophetic warning formula language and notices that this ayah turns feared punishment into announced woe from the day (26:135; 7:59; 10:15).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete parallels and the local phrase contains the same day-plus-tremendous wording.

topics.headline: indefinite cadence binds clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears doom, day, and greatness connected by repeated indefinite endings.
topics.reason: The cadence row is supported by visible tanwīn across the local clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive adjective assigning enduring tremendousness to the day, not to the witnessing noun as an independent predicate
words.root_gloss_range: root range around greatness, magnitude, weight, rank, and importance; local adjective gives the day overwhelming scale
words.prose: {{ar:عَظِيمٍ}} ({{tr:ʿaẓīmin}}) locks onto the day by agreement, so the final scale belongs to the day inside the closing phrase. Its indefinite adjective form intensifies that day without turning the word into a divine title or separate predicate. The {{ar:ع ظ م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ẓ-m}}) field gives the ending weight, rank, and magnitude; same-surah bone language gives that abstract day-scale a bodily heaviness (19:4). Compared with punishment-greatness links (3:105; 3:176; 16:106), this wording places the scale on the day that grounds woe. Because this is the last word, with a long final cadence, the ayah lands not on the factions but on overwhelming eschatological scale.

topics.headline: agreement assigns greatness to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that greatness modifies the day itself, not the woe or witnessing noun independently.
topics.reason: Attachment and QAC identify the word as an adjective agreeing with the preceding day noun in genitive indefiniteness.

topics.headline: magnitude and rank weight the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the day as weighty in scale and rank, while local grammar keeps the adjective attached to the day.
topics.reason: The broader root magnitude field is relevant pressure, but the local adjective modifies the day rather than activating every branch independently.

topics.headline: last word leaves overwhelming scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is left with magnitude as the ayah final semantic and acoustic impression.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah, and the sound row supports the heavy closing cadence.

topics.headline: greatness shifts from punishment fields to the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scale often attached to punishment is here assigned to the day that grounds woe, while divine-title associations remain background only.
topics.reason: The parallels are meaningful, but local grammar and the indefinite adjective form block reading it as a divine title or independent divine attribute.

baseline_models.mechanism: Opinion-bound groups take mutually different routes, so divergence generated inside a shared relation converts that relation into a fault line.

activation_trace.role: The image of companions taking unlike routes supplies the active divergence that fractures a common course.
An opinion-bound group makes the plural parties coalitions organized around rival positions.
The bond joining sides makes baynihim a shared relation that disagreement ruptures, not merely empty space.

changed_reading.before: Several groups happened to disagree among themselves.
changed_reading.after: The parties are produced as rival opinion-coalitions when members of one relational field take incompatible routes from within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Blocking truth is answered by an attended, knowledge-declaring scene; the day is an overwhelming occurrence rather than a neutral date.

activation_trace.role: Blocking the truth gives disbelief the operative act that the coming scene will answer.
Presence with direct viewing makes the threatened scene an unavoidable encounter with what was denied.
Knowledge-based declaration gives the scene an evidentiary and adjudicative function, beyond spectacle.
The day as a severe occurrence turns calendar time into the event of reckoning itself.
The image of a grievous descending calamity supplies the event's crushing magnitude.

changed_reading.before: Woe is threatened for disbelief on a great future day.
changed_reading.after: Woe comes from an evidentiary event in which truth-blocking fails because the deniers must be present before what declares itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A singular saying fixed as true becomes the object of sharp verbal contest; sayings become positions, positions gather adherents, and the resulting coalitions enact ikhtilaf.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief or doctrine lets qawl become a position around which a party can form.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies the singular fixed referent that rival positions contest.
Sharp verbal wrangling supplies the process by which the truth-saying is pulled into factional argument.
The opinion-coalition branch supplies the social form produced by the preceding dispute.
Taking unlike routes supplies the final divergence of the newly legible positions.

structural_cues: 19:34 places one qawl al-haqq immediately before the plural parties of 19:37.
The sequence moves from ongoing yamtarun to resultant ikhtalafa, with 19:35-36 restating divine act and one path between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a singular truth-saying, sharp dispute, opinion-coalitions, and unlike routes; I infer that repeated claims harden into parties. A live alternative is that ahzab names groups already formed before this argument.

changed_reading.after: The parties are discourse coalitions crystallized by rival doctrinal sayings around the one saying marked as truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding singular straight path supplies a common line; the focus branch of each taking a different route turns disagreement into a spatial fan-out from that line.

activation_trace.role: The straight-road image supplies the single common course against which divergence is measured.
Uprightness and balanced straightness reinforce that the announced path is aligned rather than one option among peers.
Each person's unlike route converts doctrinal difference into departure from the just-announced line.
Opinion-bound groups make the divergent routes collective tracks rather than isolated mistakes.

structural_cues: 19:36 ends with the deictic singular 'this is a straight path'; 19:37 begins with fa- and plural parties.
The route image belongs to the focus kh-l-f inventory itself, so the context sharpens an existing anchor rather than importing a free metaphor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one straight road followed by groups taking unlike roads; I infer that 19:37 narrates a fan-out from 19:36's course. Alternatively, the road may state a norm while the disagreement remains non-spatial argument.

changed_reading.before: The parties hold different opinions after a statement of guidance.
changed_reading.after: The singular straight course visibly branches into collective rival tracks as soon as the parties take unlike routes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope moves from a screening barrier and truth-covering to witnessed presence, acute hearing and sight, manifest condition, and finally the stripping of cover named inside regret; heedlessness is exposed as the present posture before that reversal.

activation_trace.role: A screening barrier establishes the pericope's initial material image of protected visual enclosure.
Covering supplies the deniers' present action and links doctrinal refusal to the earlier screen.
Attended direct viewing makes mashhad the point where maintained distance collapses.
Auditory perception supplies one immediately post-focus mode of unavoidable reception.
Eye-sight supplies the paired visual mode that realizes the witnessing scene.
Appearance and disclosure pivot the focus root from relation between parties to the manifestness of their condition.
Stripping a cover gives the day of regret a latent material reversal of k-f-r's covering.
Deliberate heedlessness identifies the live alternative posture: maintained inattention before forced disclosure.

structural_cues: The barrier occurs near the opening; paired hearing and sight follow the focus immediately.
19:39 repeats yawm and contrasts present heedlessness and nonbelief with the completed affair.
The same b-y-n root moves from baynihim in 19:37 to mubin in 19:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier, covering, witnessed presence, hearing, sight, disclosure, stripped cover, and heedlessness; I infer a temporal reversal from chosen occlusion to compulsory perception. Alternatively, the hearing and sight may intensify judgment without recalling the earlier barrier.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are punished when they attend a frightening scene.
changed_reading.after: Their woe is an epistemic reversal: those who cover truth and remain heedless must become acute hearers and seers in the scene where cover is stripped and their condition is manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated movement aside and a screening barrier keep the sign private; Mary's return carrying it into her people reverses that motion, and the focus converts spatial separation into an internal social split.

activation_trace.role: Moving aside into a separate quarter starts the spatial withdrawal that precedes public controversy.
A screening barrier materializes the boundary between private event and surrounding people.
The repeated move aside prolongs the sign's removed, nonpublic phase.
The people as a social collective supply the public body into which the carried sign returns.
The relation joining the sides supplies the communal fabric transformed into a fissure.
Unlike routes convert the earlier physical apartness into opposed public trajectories.
Opinion-coalitions are the social residue when the returned sign is contested.

structural_cues: Intabadhat recurs at 19:16 and 19:22 before 19:27 reverses direction: she comes to her people carrying the child.
Accusation and responsive sign or speech intervene between the return and the final split from within baynihim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, barrier, repeated remoteness, return to a collective, and internal divergence; I infer that private spatial separation is converted into public social factionalization. Alternatively, Mary's withdrawal may stage privacy without causing the later parties.

changed_reading.before: The narrative ends by noting a later abstract religious disagreement.
changed_reading.after: A sign kept behind spatial boundaries reenters its people and becomes the pressure that splits a shared social relation into public opinion-coalitions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an obstetric sh-h-d branch into an eschatological noun; it remains packet-anchored because mashhad is the focus word and labor, what will emerge, and birth recur nearby. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material echo, never as the ordinary lexical sense of mashhad.

activation_trace.role: A thing laboring with what will emerge supplies the nearby process of hidden content becoming manifest.
The occurrence of birth and delivery makes emergence an explicit threshold in the surrounding sequence.
What comes out at birth is the form-distant focus branch that lets mashhad faintly echo an emergence into public presence.
Covering supplies the hidden state from which the exploratory emergence reading moves.

changed_reading.before: Mashhad is solely the public scene at which people are present.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary material register, the scene is also an emergence: what was carried, screened, and covered is brought out into undeniable public presence.

strongest_changes: The parties become discourse coalitions produced by sharp contest over the singular saying of truth, not merely a fixed list of sects.
The immediate move from one straight path to the focus branch of unlike routes spatializes disagreement as a fan-out from one course.
Covering and heedlessness are reversed by witnessed presence, acute hearing and sight, manifest condition, and stripped cover.
Repeated withdrawal, barrier, and return let the final disagreement read as a private sign becoming a public social fissure.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's sequences do more than group themes: b-y-n moves from mutual relation to mubin disclosure, kh-l-f's divergent routes answer sirat mustaqim, and sh-h-d's birth branch preserves a contained emergence echo.
remaining_uncertainties: Min baynihim may stress rupture of an existing bond, or simply locate disagreement among the members.
The barrier-to-disclosure arc may be deliberate architecture, or a reader-supplied long-range echo.
The obstetric sh-h-d activation is branch-valid but form-distant and must remain secondary.

baseline.text: Fakat gruplar kendi aralarında ayrılığa düştüler. Büyük günün karşılaşması yüzünden inkâr edenlerin vay hâline!

findings.text: Bugün ayrı iddialara bölünen gruplar, gelecekte hepsinin hazır bulunup göreceği ortak ve ezici karşılaşmada bir araya gelecektir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Near-verbatim parallel: factions differ and the wrongdoers face woe from a painful Day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Links disagreement to God's judgment on the Day of Resurrection, though over Sabbath observance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mary's slander supplies a concrete later example of the false claims surrounding her and Jesus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly parallels the woe for disbelievers from their promised Day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.note: The greatness of Abraham's ransom does not clarify disagreement, disbelief, or the Day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Within the same surah, Abraham warns of punishment for rejecting God, echoing the focus warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (19:16-40) - Birth Through Churning, Harvest, and Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Enclosed life becomes manifest through agitation and is then sustained by a coordinated economy of fruit, water, and prepared drink.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Obstetrics, orchard work, irrigation, and beverage preparation form distinct but consecutive operations.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Date infusion and rationed drink
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fruit is steeped, milk is diluted, a water share is measured, and the drink is thickened or improved.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dates or raisins cast into a water vessel (`quranic:root_001466:B006/m01`); milk diluted by poured water (`quranic:root_001501:B007/m01`); allotted water share (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); thickened syrup used to improve food or skins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); recurring turn at water (`quranic:root_000315:B002/m01`); liquid poured at once into a vessel (`quranic:root_001215:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The palm-and-water provision activates a distinct preparation scene. Dates are steeped, liquid is apportioned and poured, and milk or syrup is adjusted in consistency. The process extends nourishment from raw harvest to a managed drink.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (19:16-40) - Public Proof Against Imputed Guilt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A contested person is exposed before a community, then vindicated through embodied indication, speech, and converging evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cutting and stitching, bodily wounding, legal acknowledgment, and witness-language materialize the conflict over Mary's reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Evidence moves from covered perception to witnessed clarity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hearing, sight, testimony, and explanation converge as concealed truth becomes public evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ocular seeing (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding and compliance after hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); witnessed presence (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); testimony that declares known fact (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); witness as articulating tongue (`quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`); disclosed evidence (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); explanation by speech or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); covering that becomes denial (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); uncovering a protective screen (`quranic:root_000320:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 19:37 (ب ي ن, ك ف ر, ش ه د); 19:38 (س م ع, ب ص ر); 19:39 (ح س ر)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The close of the pericope is an evidentiary process. Perception becomes understanding, presence becomes testimony, and sign becomes explanation. Denial remains a covering operation, while the day of regret removes that cover.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (19:16-40) - Effective Word and Settled Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A valid word does not remain descriptive; it determines, fabricates, and settles an outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Command resembles workshop fabrication, while truth resembles tight weave and fitted joint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Truth tested through dispute and fitted proof
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rival claims contest a truth that is progressively established, tightened, and fitted into its proper place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing truth by proof (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); tightly woven cloth or exact speech (`quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`); fitted joint or container (`quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`); sharp verbal disputation (`quranic:root_001416:B003/m01`); doubt and hesitation (`quranic:root_001416:B004/m01`); denial of another's right (`quranic:root_001416:B005/m01`); divergent paths and claims (`quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`); faction aligned around an opinion (`quranic:root_000315:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Dispute loosens what truth fixes. The true claim is figured as exact weave and a joint seated in its proper socket, whereas contention pulls parties onto divergent paths. Decree closes the contest by fixing the relation.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyden sonra gelerek onun yerini, görevini veya işlevini üstlenmesidir. Bir kimsenin ailesinin işlerini yürütme ve yitirilenin yerine karşılık sağlama, belirli yapılara bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam salt arka konum değil, hareket edenlerden ayrılıp kalma veya yetersizlik nedeniyle gecikmedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimlerle tanıklanır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğinden türetilmeden geride kalma ve kalan kişi kapsamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun giden üyelerinden ayrılıp yerinde kalanlar veya eksiklik ve yetersizlik yüzünden ötekilerin gerisinde kalan kişidir. Evde kalan kadınlar, erkeklerin ayrıldığı topluluk bağlamındaki özel örnektir.

facets.statement: Kişi veya grup, hareket edenlerin ardından gitmeyip bulunduğu yerde kalır.
Erkekler yolculuk veya savaşa gittiğinde evde kalan kadınlar ve topluluk bu anlamın belirli sosyal görünümüdür.
Eksiklik, yetersizlik veya kusur yüzünden başkalarının gerisinde kalma kişiye yönelik değerlendirmeye dönüşür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, giden erkeklerin ardından evde kalan kadınları ve daha genel olarak geri kalan veya geciken kişiyi birlikte gösterir. Bazı kullanımlarda geride kalma, kişideki eksiklik veya yetersizlikle açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir grubun giden üyelerine katılmayıp kalanlar veya yetersizlik nedeniyle başkalarından geri kalan kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem topluluktan ayrılıp yerinde kalmayı hem de yetersizlik nedeniyle geri kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun erkekleri ayrıldığında evde kalan kadınların veya hane üyelerinin anlatıldığı tarihsel bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Giden gruba katılmayıp bulunduğu yerde kalma durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yetersizlik veya kusur nedeniyle geri kalan tek kişiyi kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin eksiklik veya yetersizlik yüzünden başkalarının gerisinde kaldığının özellikle belirtildiği yerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geride kalmayı kişisel yetersizlik şartıyla birlikte korur.
error_profile.loses: Topluluk ayrıldığında evde kalanlar anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: erkekler ayrıldığında evlerde kalan kadınlar veya topluluk
eksiklik veya yetersizlik yüzünden geri kalan kimse

error_profile.preserves: Ötekilere göre geride bulunma görüntüsünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gidenlere katılmama ve yetersizlik nedeniyle gecikme olayını siler.
error_profile.adds: Kişi veya topluluk yerine salt mekansal bir yön anlamı ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Giden gruba katılmayıp kalmayı veya yetersizlik nedeniyle gecikmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir hareket ya da eksiklik olmadan salt arka konumu bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da başkalarına göre geride olma ilişkisi görülür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir ayrılma, kalma veya gecikme olayı içerir; komşu dal yalnızca göreli konumu veya sonralığı gösterebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eksiklik bir kişinin geri kalmasının nedeni olarak verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kötülük ve değersizlik, sözün, kişinin veya sonraki topluluğun niteliğini doğrudan değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişideki eksiklik veya kusurla bağlantı kurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada kusur geride kalmayı açıklar; komşu dalda ise kusur veya kötülük doğrudan varlığın niteliğidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; diğerleri yalnız uzak tema veya olay ortaklığı taşıdığı için, sınırı doğrudan açıklayan arka konum ve nitelik düşüklüğü karşılaştırmaları seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التخلف عن السائرين أو الغازين، والخوالف والحي الخلوف، والمتأخر لنقص أو قعود.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الخلف بمعنى الخليفة، ولا مجرد المكان الخلفي الجامد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخوالف هن النساء؛ الحي خلوف إذا كان الرجال غيبا والنساء مقيمات (maqayis)؛ الخوالف يعني النساء؛ حي خلوف أي غيب (ayn)؛ حي خلوف إذا غزا الرجال وبقي النساء (jamhara)؛ الخوالف أي مع النساء؛ حي خلوف أي غيب؛ الحضور المتخلفون (sihah)؛ الخالف المتأخر لنقصان؛ الخالفة المرأة؛ الحي خلوفا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, tarafların aynı yolu izlemeyip birbirinden ayrı yön tutmasını temel alır ve bunu görüş ayrılığı, karşı çıkma, çekişme ve tartışmaya uzatır. Karşılıklı iki yandan yapılan eylem ise belirli yapıya bağlı bir uygulamadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her çeşit farklılık değil, tarafların yol, görüş veya tutum bakımından ayrılması ya da birbirine karşı çıkması söz konusudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ayrışma ve karşı çıkma çekirdeği korunur; karşılıklı iki yandan olma anlamı yalnız tanıklanan yapıya bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok tarafın aynı yolu, görüşü ya da tutumu izlemeyip ayrı yönler tutması ve gerektiğinde birbirine karşı çıkmasıdır. Bu ayrışma görüş uyuşmazlığına, çekişmeye veya tartışmaya dönüşebilir.

facets.statement: Taraflar aynı yolu veya tutumu izlemek yerine birbirinden ayrı yönler tutar.
Yol ve tutum ayrılığı, görüş uyuşmazlığı, karşı çıkma, çekişme ve tartışmaya uzanır.
İki uzvun karşılıklı farklı yanlardan kesilmesi, yalnız belirli yapıda görülen yönsel uzmanlaşmadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, her tarafın ötekinin yolundan başka bir yol tutmasını ayrışmanın çekirdeği sayar. Bu çekirdek görüşlerin uyuşmaması, buyruğa karşı gelme, çekişme ve tartışma alanlarına taşınır; karşılıklı yanlar kullanımı yapı bağımlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tarafların yol, görüş veya tutum bakımından ayrıldığı ve birbiriyle uyuşmadığı durumlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı yön tutma çekirdeğini ve bunun karşı çıkma ya da uyuşmazlığa uzanmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların bir konu hakkında farklı görüşler benimsediği ve birbirinin sözünü kabul etmediği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların aynı görüşü izlemeyip ayrılmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Buyruğa karşı gelme ve fiziksel olarak karşılıklı yanlarda bulunma kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kendisine verilen yönlendirmeyi veya buyruğu izlemeyip ters yönde davrandığı bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının tuttuğu veya gösterdiği yoldan ayrılma ve karşı çıkma öğesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Karşılıklı görüş ayrılığı ile tarafsız çeşitlenme kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki uzvun birbirine karşıt yanlardan işleme uğradığını bildiren özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların farklı ve karşıt yönlerde bulunması ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüş ayrılığı, karşı çıkma ve çekişme anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: başka bir yol tutmak, karşı çıkmak veya uyuşmamak
görüş veya durum bakımından ayrışma; çekişmeye dönüşebilen uyuşmazlık

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar veya durumlar arasındaki aynı olmama özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayrı yol tutma, karşı çıkma ve uyuşmazlık ilişkisini zorunlu kılmaz.
error_profile.adds: Çekişme veya yön ayrılığı içermeyen her türlü tarafsız çeşitliliği kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Sıradan nitelik ve görünüş farklılıklarıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrışmanın sözlü çekişmeye dönüşen görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tartışmaya dönüşmeyen yol, tutum ve davranış ayrılığını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Görüş ayrılığı, buyruğa karşı gelme ve çekişme dahil geniş bir ayrışma alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tek bir kalıplaşmış eylemde bir kişinin ötekine karşı davranmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel ayrışma ile tekil karşı çıkma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin ötekinin yolunu veya tutumunu izlememesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ayrışmanın kavramsal alanını ve sonuçlarını kapsar; komşu dal aynı çekirdeğin tekil ve dar bir eylem ifadesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öfke veya açık kavga olmadan da yol ve görüş ayrılığı bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Öfkelenme, topluluktan çıkma, küsme ve açık çekişme gibi çatışmalı sonuçları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da taraflar birbirine karşı durabilir ve uyuşmazlık yaşayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği farklı yol veya tutum seçmektir; komşu dal karşıtlığı öfke, kopuş ve çatışmalı davranışla belirginleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyuşmazlığın tartışmaya dönüşmeden önceki yol ve görüş ayrılığını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözlerin birbirine karıştığı karşılıklı ve yoğun bir çekişmeyi öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlık ve tartışma alanına girebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ayrışmayı temel alır ve tartışmayı olası uzantı sayar; komşu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan karşılıklı sözlü çekişmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yol, görüş veya buyruk bakımından genel karşı çıkmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Geleceğe ilişkin verilmiş bir sözün yerine getirilmemesi şartına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Sözünü tutmama, önceki bildirim veya beklentiyle ters düşen bir davranıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal herhangi bir yol veya tutum ayrılığını kapsar; komşu dal yalnız gelecek için verilen sözün gerçekleşmemesini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı gözden geçirildi; genel ayrışmayı dar karşı çıkma, öfkeli çekişme, sözlü kavga ve sözünü tutmamadan ayıran dört sınır seçildi.
branches.branch_image_ar: كل واحد يأخذ طريقا غير طريق صاحبه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخلاف والمخالفة والاختلاف والتنازع، ومخالفة الرسول أو الأمر، واختلاف الأقوال والألوان والأحوال.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس خصوص إخلاف الوعد، ولا التعاقب الذي يخلف فيه أحدهما الآخر بلا نزاع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: اختلف الناس في كذا؛ كل واحد منهم ينحي قول صاحبه (maqayis)؛ خلاف رسول الله مخالفته؛ رجل خالف؛ اختلفت (ayn)؛ خالفني الرجل مخالفة وخلافا؛ في فلان خلفة أي مخالف لما أمرته (jamhara)؛ الخلاف المخالفة؛ خلاف رسول الله أي مخالفة رسول الله (sihah)؛ الاختلاف والمخالفة أن يأخذ كل واحد طريقا غير طريق الآخر؛ استعير ذلك للمنازعة والمجادلة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geleceğe yönelik verilen sözün veya belirlenen zamanın gerçekleşmemesini açıkça merkeze alır. Geçmişe ilişkin yanlış bildirimden ve söz içermeyen genel karşı çıkmadan ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, geleceğe dönük bir söz veya belirlenmiş zaman bulunmasını ve bunun yerine getirilmemesini gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad ve kişi niteliği, yalnız söz verme yapısında gerçekleşen eylemden ayrılır; dal bütün karşı çıkmalara genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin gelecek için verdiği sözü yerine getirmemesi veya kararlaştırılmış zamanda beklenen şeyi gerçekleştirmemesidir. Bunu sürekli yapan kişi, sözünü sık sık tutmayan biri olarak nitelenir.

facets.statement: Geleceğe ilişkin bir söz verilir, fakat söylenen eylem gerçekleşmez.
Belirlenen zamanın karşılanmaması, sözün yerine getirilmemesinin zaman odaklı görünümüdür.
Sözünü sürekli tutmayan kişi, eylemin tekrarlanan bir kişilik özelliğiyle nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, geleceğe dönük söylenen şeyin yapılmamasını sözün boşa çıkması olarak tanımlar ve bunu geçmiş hakkında yanlış söylemekten ayırır. Ad, eylem ve bu davranışı sık yapan kişi niteliği aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gelecek için üstlenilen bir işin yapılmadığı veya kararlaştırılmış zamanın karşılanmadığı durumlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geleceğe yönelik söz, beklenti ve yerine getirmeme öğelerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin daha önce verdiği sözü yerine getirmediği günlük anlatım bağlamlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Verilmiş bir sözün daha sonra yerine getirilmemesi ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bu davranışı çok kez gösteren bir kişinin kalıcı veya tekrarlanan niteliği anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözün yerine getirilmemesi ve bunun tekrarlanması öğelerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek seferlik sözünü tutmama olayını kişi niteliğine dönüştürmeden anlatamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: verilen sözün veya belirlenen zamanın yerine getirilmemesi

error_profile.preserves: Söylenen ile gerçekleşen arasındaki uyuşmazlığı koruyabilir.
error_profile.loses: Geleceğe dönük söz ve onu yerine getirmeme zaman yapısını zorunlu kılmaz.
error_profile.adds: Geçmiş veya şimdiki durumlar hakkında her türlü bilerek yanlış bildirimi kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Geçmişe ilişkin gerçek dışı sözlerle karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki beklentiyle uyuşmayan davranışı koruyabilir.
error_profile.loses: Verilmiş söz ve gelecekte yerine getirme yükünü siler.
error_profile.adds: Söz bulunmayan her türlü buyruk veya tutum karşıtlığını kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel ayrışma ve karşı çıkma dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözünü tutmamanın genel adını, eylemini ve bunu sık yapan kişi niteliğini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözünü tutmayan kişiyi belirli bir benzetme ve kalıplaşmış deyiş içinde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel söz bozma ile kalıplaşmış örnek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da söz verip daha sonra onu yerine getirmeyen kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal üretken ve genel sözünü tutmama anlamıdır; komşu dal aynı durumu belirli bir kalıplaşmış örnek üzerinden ifade eder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Verilmiş sözün daha sonra yerine getirilmemesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi veya kötü bir şeyi gelecekte yapacağını bildirme ve karşı tarafta beklenti oluşturma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal geleceğe ilişkin bir bildirim ve yükümlülük çevresinde kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal söz verme anını ve doğan beklentiyi anlatır; bu dal ancak o söz gerçekleşmediğinde ortaya çıkan başarısızlığı adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her türlü gelecek sözü veya belirlenmiş zamanın karşılanmamasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle yeminle üstlenilmiş yükümlülüğün bozulmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin üstlendiği bir yükümlülüğe aykırı davranmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal için sıradan bir söz yeterlidir; komşu dalda bağlayıcı unsur yemin olduğu için kapsam daha özel ve törenseldir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gelecek için söylenen belirli bir şeyin yapılmamasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gizli güveni, emaneti, hakkı veya bağı kötüye kullanmayı ve genel sadakatsizliği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sözünü tutmama ile güveni kötüye kullanma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da beklenen bağlılık ve güvenin boşa çıkması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal verilmiş sözün gerçekleşmemesidir; komşu dal söz bulunmasa da emanet, hak veya güven ilişkisinin çiğnenmesini anlatabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel anlamı kalıplaşmış örnekten, söz verme eyleminden, yemin bozmadan ve güveni kötüye kullanmadan ayıran dört karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخلف والإخلاف في الوعد والميعاد، وأن يقول المرء شيئا في المستقبل ولا يفعله أو يوجد موعده خلفا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكذب الماضي، ولا كل مخالفة أو اختلاف بلا وعد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, iki veya daha çok öğeden her birinin ötekinin ardından gelmesini ve bunun sıra ya da dönüşüm halinde yinelenmesini destekler. Yerine geçme görülebilse de yönetim görevi devralmak anlamın şartı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın belirleyici öğesi nöbetleşme veya düzenli ardışıklıktır; kalıcı görev devri değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel dönüşümlü sıra ile gece ve gündüze bağlı özel yapı ayrı gösterilir; özel örnek bütün dala göksel bir kapsam yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok öğenin sırayla birbirinin ardından gelmesi, biri gidince ötekinin gelmesi ya da grupların birbiri ardınca ilerlemesidir. Gece ile gündüzün birbirini izlemesi bunun düzenli doğal örneğidir.

facets.statement: Öğeler sırayla birbirinin ardından gelir ve sıra yeniden ötekine geçebilir.
Toplulukların veya hareket eden birimlerin grup grup ve birbiri ardınca gelmesi dönüşümün çizgisel görünümüdür.
Gece ve gündüzün birbirinin ardından gelmesi düzenli karşılıklı dönüşümün örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, birinin ardından ötekinin geldiği dönüşümlü sırayı; su çekme nöbetlerini, grup grup ilerlemeyi ve gece ile gündüzün birbirini izlemesini aynı düzen altında toplar. Çekirdek, kalıcı makam devrinden bağımsızdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Öğelerin nöbetleştiği, biri gidince ötekinin geldiği veya grupların düzenli biçimde birbirini izlediği durumlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sıra, ardışıklık ve karşılıklı dönüşüm öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki veya daha çok kişi, durum ya da zaman dilimi sırayla birbirinin yerini aldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı sıra ve birinin ardından ötekinin gelmesi ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Grupların, bölüklerin veya hareketlerin sıra halinde peş peşe geldiği bağlamlara uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi değişmeyi ortak başlık olarak verir, fakat örneklerin hepsi tarafsız değişim değildir: ağız ve yiyecekte koku ya da tat bozulması, giyside yıpranma ve hayvanda hastalığa bağlı yana eğilme öne çıkar. Bu nedenle dal olumsuz veya kusurlu duruma geçişle sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her değişiklik değil, önceki düzgün durumdan bozulma, yıpranma veya hastalıklı sapma yönündeki değişim anlatılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel bozulma çekirdeği ile ağız, yiyecek ve süt yapıları ayrı tutulur; giysi ve hayvan adları yalın ama sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin önceki düzgün durumundan çıkarak kokusunun, tadının, yapısının veya genel niteliğinin bozulmasıdır. Ortası yıpranıp onarılan giysi ve hastalık yüzünden bir yana eğik yürüyen deve, bu olumsuz değişimin sabit sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalarıdır.

facets.statement: Şey, önceki düzgün halinden bozuk veya kusurlu bir duruma değişir.
Ağız kokusunun ve süt ya da yiyeceğin tat veya kokusunun değişmesi duyusal bozulmadır.
Ortası yıpranan bölümü çıkarılıp onarılan giysi, yapısal bozulmaya bağlı sabit bir addır.
Hastalık nedeniyle bir yana eğik yürüyen deve, bedensel sapmaya bağlı sabit bir nitelemedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, değişimi bozulma yönünde somutlaştırır: ağız kokusu değişir, süt ve yiyecek ekşir veya bozulur, söz ya da kişi düzgünlüğünü yitirir. Yıpranmış giysi ve yana eğik yürüyen deve bu alanın özel adlandırmalarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yıpranmanın yanında koku, tat, genel nitelik ve bedensel duruş bozulmasını da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin zamanla veya hastalıkla bozuk duruma geçişini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kötü veya değersiz sözü, öncekinin ardından gelen kötü topluluğu ve kendisinde iyilik bulunmayan ya da sürekli ters davranan kişiyi ortak bir aşağı nitelik ekseninde birleştirir. Bu, iyi ardıl veya kabul edilebilir görev devri değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sonradan gelmeyi değil, sözün, kişinin veya ardıl topluluğun kötü ve değersiz niteliğini öne çıkarır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimlerin kötü nitelik alanıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki söz öbeklerinden karşı çıkma veya ardıllık anlamı alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün, kişinin veya önceki kuşaktan sonra gelen topluluğun kötü, değersiz ya da yararsız olmasıdır. Kişi için sürekli ters davranma, iyilik taşımama veya budalalık bu olumsuz niteliğin görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Söz, kişi veya topluluk iyi ve değerli olması beklenen ölçünün altında, kötü niteliktedir.
Öncekilerin ardından gelen kötü topluluk veya kötü söz, niteliğin belirli taşıyıcılarıdır.
İyilik taşımayan, sürekli ters davranan veya budalaca davranan kişi aynı aşağı nitelikle değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, kötü söz ile kötü ardıl topluluğu aynı değersizlik niteliğinde buluşturur ve bu niteliği iyilik taşımayan, çok karşı çıkan veya budala kişiye uygular. Olumlu ardıllık anlamı bu dalın dışında kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün, kişinin veya sonradan gelen topluluğun nitelik bakımından kötü, yararsız veya aşağı sayıldığı durumlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumsuz nitelik, değersizlik ve farklı taşıyıcılara uygulanabilme kapsamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kötülük ve yararsızlığı içerik ya da davranış niteliği olarak verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşağı toplumsal konum, küçüklük ve bayağılık değerlendirmesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişi veya şey hakkında olumsuz değer yargısı bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın ölçütü kötü veya yararsız niteliktir; komşu dalın ölçütü düşüklük, küçüklük ve aşağı konumdur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kötü niteliği bir değişim süreci aramadan doğrudan bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin önceki düzgün durumundan bozuk duruma geçmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kusurlu veya olumsuz bir durumu gösterebilir.
